description: Asset Workspace settings: hand-over acknowledgements, defaults and asset naming. Managed from Asset Workspace > Settings.

fields.description: When an asset is assigned or transferred to an employee, email them an acknowledgement link. Untick to stop the emails (no acknowledgement is requested).
fields.label: Ask Employees to Acknowledge Assets

fields.description: Copied (CC) on every acknowledgement email. Separate several addresses with commas.
fields.label: IT Team Emails (CC)

fields.default: Please check the asset(s) below and confirm that you have received them in the condition shown.
fields.description: Shown to the employee in the email and on the acknowledgement page.
fields.label: Message to the Employee

fields.description: IT must give each asset a 1 to 5 star condition when assigning or transferring it to an employee.
fields.label: Condition Rating Required at Hand-over

fields.description: Warranties and subscription renewals ending within this many days are flagged on the dashboard and lists.
fields.label: Warranty / Renewal Alert (days)

fields.description: The Asset naming series to offer, one per line. .{item_name}. - .### gives "Macbook Air M1 - 001" (a counter per model); ACC-ASS-.YYYY.- gives ACC-ASS-2026-00001.
fields.label: Naming Series

fields.description: Used for new assets (one of the series on the left).
fields.label: Default Series

name: Asset Management Settings
